title: TalentRL: Strategy-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Skill Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.41143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language skills enable large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures across tasks, yet most systems retrieve individual skills from a flat SkillBank without explicitly modeling the high-level strategy that governs their selection and use. We introduce TalentRL, a strategy-guided reinforcement learning framework for hierarchical routing over procedural memory. Coarse-grained talents represent recurring strategies for skill use, while fine-grained skills provide executable procedures. For each task, the policy model selects a talent that guides execution and softly prioritizes its associated skills during similarity-based retrieval. However, since task outcomes depend jointly on talent selection, retrieved skill context, and downstream execution, terminal rewards alone cannot isolate the contribution of the routing decision. TalentRL therefore trains talent routing with reward contrasts between rollouts of the same task und

translated_title: TalentRL：面向层次化技能路由的策略引导强化学习
translated_abstract: 自然语言技能使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够在不同任务间复用程序性流程，然而大多数系统仅从扁平的技能库中检索单个技能，未能显式建模支配技能选择与使用的高层策略。我们提出了TalentRL，这是一个策略引导的强化学习框架，用于对程序性记忆进行层次化路由。粗粒度的“才能”表示技能使用中反复出现的策略，而细粒度的技能提供可执行的程序。对于每个任务，策略模型选择一个才能来指导执行，并在基于相似度的检索过程中对相关联的技能进行软性优先排序。然而，由于任务结果共同依赖于才能选择、检索到的技能上下文以及下游执行，仅凭终端奖励无法分离出路由决策本身的贡献。因此，TalentRL通过同一任务不同回放之间的奖励对比来训练才能路由策略……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了TalentRL框架，以强化学习结合同一任务回放间的奖励对比来训练粗粒度“才能”的路由策略，实现层次化程序性记忆中策略引导的技能选择与检索。
en_tdlr: TalentRL is a strategy-guided reinforcement learning framework that performs hierarchical routing over procedural memory, training coarse-grained talent selection via reward contrasts between rollouts of the same task to guide skill retrieval and execution.
